_note: Yfory, the playable game. Placeholders in braces are filled by the UI. Plural keys have one and other forms.
title: Yfory
hook.line: This is Wales in 2026. In 2050 someone will write to you about what you did with it.
hook.touch: Point at a place you know. Every figure here is real.
bar.modified: You are playing a modified rule set
opening.arrived: Arrived from the post this term
opening.no_new_trend: No new trend from the horizon scan this term.
opening.returning: You are back in the seat. Trust is thin and the budget is one pip short this term.
slip.peek_note: Once a term. Turns over next term’s curveball now.
pledge.ask: They ask you for one promise this term.
pledge.declined: You made no promise this term.
pledge.note: Keep it and Trust rises. Let {strand} fall and Trust falls further.
plan.contingency.one: 1 pip held back for a shock
plan.contingency.other: {n} pips held back for a shock
plan.contingency_none: Nothing held back for a shock
plan.choose_region: Choose a region on the map or below.
plan.visit_card: Played, it will take you to {place}.
plan.cannot_limit: Trust allows no more cards this term.
plan.cannot_budget: Not enough pips left this term.
plan.commit_note: Pips you leave unspent are held back for a shock.
plan.nothing_played: You have played nothing. Standing still is losing, slowly.
plan.ghost_plan: With your plan as it stands
plan.ghost_fuzzy: fuzzy: could be one pip either way
plan.ghost_none: No visible move on any strand
plan.keys: Arrow keys move through the hand. Enter selects. P plays.
plan.problem.wrong_step: This is not the planning step.
plan.problem.not_in_hand: That card is not in your hand.
plan.problem.duplicate: That card is already played this term.
plan.problem.over_limit: Trust allows no more cards this term.
plan.problem.over_budget: Not enough pips left this term.
plan.problem.compact_not_in_force: No compact is in force there.
plan.problem.standing_unknown: That standing ticket does not exist.
plan.problem.debt_max: You already hold the most debt allowed.
plan.problem.no_debt: There is no debt to clear.
plan.problem.hold_over_invalid: Only an unplayed card can be kept.
ledger.title: Ledger drawer
ledger.standing_note: They use no card slot. At most one a term.
ledger.repay_cancel: Do not clear it this term
post.label: In the post
post.after: Lands after 2050: it still counts for those who come after.
timeline.label: 2026 to 2050, six terms
region.highlight: The four regions are lit on the map.
visit.why: {card} is delivered there this term. Your threads decide how well it lands.
visit.stay_note: If you stay, it is delivered as planned, without your threads.
passing.title: {from} to {to}
passing.quiet: No shock this term. The term runs its course.
shock.label: A shock lands
shock.ready_by: {cards} softened the hit before you spent anything.
shock.explain: Absorbed, it hits in full. One pip halves it. Two pips quarter it.
shock.fragile: Repairs put off make this hit harder.
changed.title: What changed, {from} to {to}
changed.no_slips: Nothing moved enough to tell apart this term.
event.R12: A tip moving in the storm
event.R20: A heartland falling below half Welsh-speaking
trace.title: Pull the thread
trace.strand_line: {strand} moved from {from} to {to} pips. This thread carries part of that.
trace.sharp: Sharp: most runs agree on the pip.
trace.fuzzy: Fuzzy: it could be one pip either way.
trace.placeholder: Placeholder: this rule awaits better evidence.
trace.no_rule: Carried directly by the card’s own effect.
trace.ending: The national strand moves in pips and bands. Place counts are not added up.
trace.none: No single cause is large enough to trace here.
trust.label: Trust: {band}
trust.reason.pips_gained: People can see things getting better.
trust.reason.gap_narrowed: The worst-off places closed the gap a little.
trust.reason.gap_widened: The worst-off places fell further behind.
trust.reason.shock_prepared: You were ready for the shock.
trust.reason.shock_responded: You met the shock with what you held back.
trust.reason.debt_interest: Interest on the debt is showing.
trust.reason.drift: Trust drifted back towards the middle.
trust.reason.shadow_pledge: Your promise from the benches held.
trust.reason.return: You came back to the seat.
election.title: The election, {year}
election.lost: You have lost the seat. A caretaker holds the next term.
caretaker.title: From the opposition benches
caretaker.body: A caretaker plays the cheapest cards and holds the line. You can make one promise from the benches.
caretaker.shadow_note: If that strand does not fall, you return with a little more Trust.
voice.label: Illustrative voice, not a real quote
onboard.hand: These are your cards. Point at one to see what it would move.
onboard.ticket: The left side costs now. The right side says when it pays.
onboard.play: Open a ticket, then play it, or choose where it goes.
onboard.post: It is in the post. It lands on the timeline when it pays out.
onboard.commit: Pips you leave unspent are held back for a shock.
onboard.strands: Yarn is how people fare now. The cross is what is handed on.
onboard.pull: Pull any thread to see why it moved.
onboard.trust: Trust sets how many cards you may play next term.
onboard.region: This card needs a region. The map lights the four.
map.failed: The map data did not load. Check your connection, then try again.
map.label: Paper relief map of Wales
save.load_failed: That saved game could not be read. A new game has started.
save.shared: You are looking at a shared game.
error.model: The rules of the game did not load. Check your connection, then try again.
error.engine: The game could not take that step. Try again, or start a new game.
end.lived_note: How people fared in your years
end.fuzzy_edge: The band could sit one either side: {low} to {high}.
end.ghost_note: The caretaker, on the same seed, ends at {band}.
end.worst_note: The worst term counts extra in Lived.
end.prompt.lived_lower: Your years were the weak side. Which visible card would have bought the room to do slow things?
end.prompt.left_lower: The 2050 generation paid for your years. Which slow card would you plant earlier?
end.prompt.weakest: {strand} let you down most. What would have held it?
end.prompt.debts: You left debts. What did they buy, and was it worth it?
end.prompt.no_well: No visit was judged well. Go to {place} again and choose differently.
end.prompt.lost_seat: You lost the seat in {year}. What spent the Trust?
end.prompt.neglect: {region} went without. Would one card there have changed the letter?
end.prompt.contingency: Shocks hit in full. Would holding back one pip have paid?
end.weights_note: Weights change how the strands add up to Lived and Left. They are shown with every result.
end.share: Copy the link to this game
end.again_note: A new seed: different curveballs and hands.
foot.honesty: A thinking tool, not a forecast.
foot.attrib: Boundaries ONS (OGL). Terrain AWS Terrain Tiles. Places: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), BGS (OGL), NRW, WIMD.
plan.ghost_down: This card would wear it down
end.ghost_line: A caretaker’s Wales on the same seed: {change}.
end.vs_ahead.one: You finished about 1 pip ahead of it.
end.vs_ahead.other: You finished about {n} pips ahead of it.
end.vs_behind.one: You finished about 1 pip behind it.
end.vs_behind.other: You finished about {n} pips behind it.
end.unit: Net strand pips since 2026, across the seven strands.
end.terms_note: Each term against 2026. The first term is inherited and not counted.
end.dipped: A term you shaped fell below 2026, and counts extra in Lived.
plan.tray_hint: Choose a ticket to open it in full and play it.
plan.partners_note: Needs partners: half strength unless a regional compact is in force there, or the place visit goes well.
plan.after_2050: Lands after 2050: it will not help your years, but it counts in Left for those who come after.
sharpkey.line: Sharp: most runs agree. Fuzzy: it could be a pip either way.
end.prompt.no_visit: You never went to a place. Next time, go to the Rhondda or Bethesda when they ask.
slip.peek_answers: In your hand, these answer it: {cards}
slip.peek_none_in_hand: Nothing in your hand answers it yet.
plan.upkeep_note: Once built it needs upkeep: {pips} every {terms}.
plan.upkeep_note_each: Once built it needs upkeep: {pips} each term.
map.rings: Your work: each ring marks where a card landed.
changed.ripple: The building work for {cause} lifted {strand} for a while.
changed.response_spent.one: You spent 1 pip: {share} of the hit landed.
changed.response_spent.other: You spent {n} pips: {share} of the hit landed.
changed.response_none: You spent nothing: all of the hit landed.
changed.response_ready: A card had made you ready.
plan.staged: First effects in {first}, the rest in {full}.
opening.first_effects: First effects of {card} land now; the rest in {year}.
opening.in_full: in full now; its first effects came in {year}
changed.held_up: {strand} held; {cause} pushed it up a little.
changed.mastered: {place} is in good hands now. It runs itself, and its cards deliver well without a visit.
end.prompt.left_fine: Left came out {change}. Which slow card would you plant a term earlier to make it a gift?
trace.strand_same.one: {strand} stayed at {to} pip. This thread pulled against the rest.
trace.strand_same.other: {strand} stayed at {to} pips. This thread pulled against the rest.
visit.why_one: Because you played {card}. It is delivered there this term, and your threads decide how well it lands.
visit.why_many: Because you played {card}. They are delivered there this term, and your threads decide how well they land.
visit.why_trend: {trend} bears down on it this term. Your threads decide how well the valley copes.
visit.choose: Two places are asking. You can go to one this term.
changed.recovery_card: {strand}: the short dip from {cause} has worn off.
